more_info.overview: Beta-cryptoxanthin is a carotenoid containing an alcohol group, chemically derived from the beta-carotene structure. The compound occurs in plants, including papaya and oranges. This historical entry concerns its pigment identity. Occurrence in fruit does not establish a production route, food-use permission or intake limit for an isolated commercial colour.
